Package dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.celebration

Interface CelebrationService

public interface CelebrationService
Victory celebrations: the catalog winners choose from and the previews of the cosmetics menu.

When a match is won, each winner still in it celebrates with the celebration they chose and own - see CosmeticsService - or the server's default. VictoryCelebrationEvent lets an addon change or suppress those choices before playback starts. A celebration that fails never delays the match's restart.

Celebrations are not part of the Free edition: there isAvailable() is false, the catalog is empty and previews fail. Methods that change something must be called on the main thread.

Since:
1.8.0
